about_the_game:
Copy: Two Man Too Many tells the story of 1st November 1993, at the closed St. Valentine Mental Health Hospital. The player takes on the role of a character showing signs of amnesia who decides to escape from an ill-fated facility. It involves participating in a dangerous game where the rules will turn the reality into hell as it soon becomes clear that the hospital walls are not the biggest obstacle to overcome. The player will find and use various items, talk to other people, explore the hospital building, and avoid detection by the staff. The uncovered elements of the mystery will pose moral dilemmas to the player and force him to behave irrationally in order to escape from the hospital.

Shadows, sounds of the storm and gloomy music create a dark atmosphere. The game's seven levels will challenge logical thinking, perseverance and perceptiveness. Some items may be in different places, making the game always run differently.

Game: The demo only has the first level, 2D, isometric, black and white, pixel art, logic puzzles, arcade and random elements, psychological, unconventional story.
